question: Is the canonical training target a closed form in the solved candidate masses, independent of the objective weights?
why_it_matters: PROSPER needs per-prompt objective weights, which the shared artifact path cannot carry, so its targets must be assembled outside build_rows. That is only safe if the target does not involve the weights.
verdict: Holds exactly on every released dev pair set, across four aggregation rules and three representations. The residuals are float64 rounding. The target is a property of the canonical realization, not of any particular rule, so PROSPER may assemble it from per-prompt solved masses without touching the shared artifact path.
split_checked: dev only; the train files are 9 GB each and the dev files already cover every rule and representation
